phases.prefix: model.backbone(backbone_inputs) -- the whole VLM, vision INSIDE
phases.ae: model.action_head.get_action on a backbone output computed once; contains the num_inference_timesteps loop
phases.full: model.get_action(inputs) on already-collated inputs, i.e. the GPU path only -- prepare_input (CPU) is outside all three loops

notes: The memory rail is measured at the regulator INPUT (~5.04 V) and is NOT rescaled to 1.8 V. It is an upper bound on DRAM power; quote its above-idle delta next to the absolute value, and never call it 'DRAM power' without those words (protocol §4).
Each rail is reported separately, as module power (all four) and as the three-rail sum without the memory rail.
T005 checked the four rails for double-counting and found none: a load that raises VDD_GPU_SOC by 51.8 W raises VIN_SYS_5V0 by only 8.7 W. They may be summed.
An idle baseline was measured in this power mode, for this duration, before the loops.
tegrastats --logfile appends, so each log is deleted before its run (T001).
prefix and ae are driven BELOW model.get_action, so if a compile mode was applied to get_action itself they would not go through it. This run compiled: nothing (eager).

GR00T's prefix loop includes its vision encoder, as the LeRobot models' prefix loop does. Splitting vision out again would need a fourth loop driving .visual on inputs the backbone builds internally; it is not attempted here.
